title: Pre-registered predictions for all owed GPU/QPU runs + blind holdout (EIGENNEXUS, GIC 2026 Phase 3)
committed: 2026-07-03 (git history of this file is the tamper-evident timestamp; commit precedes any qBraid GPU/QPU access and precedes the first execution of the blind-holdout script)
discipline: Clinical-trial-style pre-registration applied to the owed at-scale runs: every prediction below is derived ONLY from already-committed measured data (cited per entry). Each has an explicit pass/fail threshold. Outcomes will be reported as-is, pass or fail; no threshold will be moved after execution.

predictions.prediction: With bond dimension chi=400, the MPS-evaluated pipeline reaches |E - E_DMRG(chi=400)| <= 1.6 mHa (chemical accuracy vs the classical MPS reference in the same basis/geometry).
predictions.basis: results/mps_bonddim_evidence.json: measured chi_for_chem_acc = 400 at 40q (block2 DMRG, classical analogue of tensornet-mps).
predictions.pass_fail: PASS if <=1.6 mHa; FAIL otherwise (reported either way).

predictions.run: 40q QSCI determinant budget (GPU-sampled or proxy at scale)
predictions.prediction: Determinants needed for chemical accuracy at 40q lie in [3e5, 4e6] (point estimate 1.13e6).
predictions.basis: results/encoder/scaling_law_evidence.json: 1.383x/qubit fit, log-space R2=0.99, measured 8-28q; band = roughly half a decade around the extrapolation.
predictions.pass_fail: PASS if the converged budget falls inside the band.

predictions.prediction: Peak MPS tensor storage for the chi=400 run stays under 8 GB device memory (leading-order estimate 0.2 GB; 40x engineering margin for workspace/copies).
predictions.pass_fail: PASS if peak device memory < 8 GB.

predictions.prediction: QSCI reaches <= 1.6 mHa vs a block2 DMRG reference computed in the SAME active space.
predictions.basis: EXTRAPOLATION: executed 20q CrO/NiO (0.038/0.197 mHa, transition_metal_qsci_evidence.json) + determinant scaling law. No committed 38q TM-oxide data exists; this is the least-grounded prediction and is labeled as such.
predictions.pass_fail: PASS if <=1.6 mHa vs same-CAS DMRG; partial results reported as-is.

predictions.run: Real QPU validation (IonQ/IBM via qBraid), 12q H6 QSCI
predictions.prediction: Determinant selection from >=10,000 hardware shots, followed by classical subspace diagonalization, yields |E - FCI| <= 5 mHa (looser than the noiseless 1.05 mHa because of hardware noise).
predictions.basis: results/gqe_qsci_evidence.json (12q measured, 1.05 mHa noiseless) + results/cudaq_noise_evidence.json (chemical accuracy held to 5%/gate depolarizing at 8q via density-matrix-cpu).
predictions.pass_fail: PASS if <=5 mHa; the raw hardware counts will be committed regardless.
predictions.flight_protocol: 3 pooled jobs (MP2 + 2 seeded-random angles, seed 7), >=10k shots total; see protocol_amendments

predictions.run: BLIND ONE-SHOT HOLDOUT: VO quartet-vs-doublet (executable now on CPU; frozen before first run)
predictions.prediction: (a) QSCI reproduces CASCI to <=1.6 mHa for both spin states; (b) CASCI(11,10)/def2-SVP orders the quartet below the doublet, matching the experimental X4Sigma- ground term.
predictions.basis: Method identical to committed CrO pipeline (cro_spin_gap.py); VO appears NOWHERE in this repository before this file. (b) is genuinely blind: a modest CAS may fail it, and that outcome will be committed unedited.
predictions.pass_fail: Reported as-is after exactly one execution of src/blind_holdout_vo.py.

honest_notes: Predictions P1-P5 concern runs gated on qBraid access; they are commitments about FUTURE results, not claims of achieved results.
If any prediction fails, the failure is reported in the final submission with the same prominence as a success.
Timestamp integrity: verify via git log --follow results/preregistration_v1.json and the commit hashes on the remote.

protocol_amendments.amends: P5 flight protocol (NOT the threshold — unchanged at <=5 mHa)
protocol_amendments.what: Pre-flight dry runs on the noiseless simulator showed a single MP2-angle submission under-covers the determinant space (~16 mHa). Flight protocol fixed BEFORE any hardware execution: three pooled submissions on the same 36-excitation wire set — MP2 angles + two reproducibly seeded random-angle jobs (seed 7) — reaching +1.5 mHa noiseless (3.4x headroom). Rationale is the committed measured-random coverage finding. Implemented in src/qpu_run_h6.py.
protocol_amendments.integrity: Amendment committed before any QPU job; git history is the timestamp.
